headline: 8% mortgage rates are ‘not an impossibility’ as the 30-year fixed rate surges. Treasury yields rise again.
detail: Rising rates and mortgage costs can signal broader economic tightening, which often pressures growth and tech stocks, especially those on margin. This impacts your overall portfolio risk.
rec: Be aware of the increasing cost of capital, which could dampen demand for tech products and services.
